whenToUse: The same action applies to many items, such as emails or files.
The number chosen decides the result.
The action can be undone afterward.
whenNotToUse: Lists handled one item at a time.
The selection scrolls off screen and can't be seen.

alternatives.name: Swipe to Delete
alternatives.reason: Swiping one item to delete it.

alternatives.name: Checkbox
alternatives.reason: The basic form of the selection boxes.

accessibility: The action bar is role="toolbar" and reads the number chosen via aria-live.
With nothing chosen, the bar is hidden so no unusable buttons remain.
The result and undo button sit inside role="status".
